title: Arguments of `board.content` (one chunk of a picture)
description: The `authz.object.args` of a live `board.content` action. The gzip of a whole picture (an SVG) is cut into `count` chunks of at most 40,000 bytes, each sent in its own action ahead of the `board.show` that names the picture. The node stores the chunk and answers `STORED`; when all `count` chunks are there it joins them, un-gzips, and checks the size and the hash `sha256` before keeping the picture. A repeated chunk is stored again, harmlessly. The schema counts characters; core and the node also decode `data` and count bytes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the whole picture, uncompressed, lower-case hex.

encoding.description: What `data` holds once decoded from base64.

bytes.description: Size of the whole picture, uncompressed.

index.description: This chunk's place, from 0. Below `count`; core and the node check that.

count.description: How many chunks the picture has.

data.description: Standard padded base64 of at most 40,000 bytes of the gzip stream (53,336 characters at most).
